title: Sheafification at an object whose covers refine finite disjoint partitions
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] small relative to the universe of its presheaves. Assume that $\mathcal C$ has pullbacks and finite coproducts, that its initial object $\varnothing$ is strict, and that finite coproducts are disjoint and stable under pullback: $U_i\times_{\coprod_jU_j}U_k=\varnothing$ for $i\ne k$, and pulling back a coproduct decomposition gives a coproduct decomposition. Assume that the component maps of every finite coproduct decomposition form a covering family, including the empty covering of $\varnothing$. Let $W\in\mathcal C$ have the following property: every covering $\{V_i\to W\}_{i\in I}$ has a refinement consisting of the component maps of a finite decomposition $W\cong\coprod_{a=1}^m W_a$, with each $W_a\to W$ factoring through some $V_i$. Let $P:\mathcal C^{op}\to\operatorname{Set}$ be a presheaf such that $P(\varnothing)$ is a singleton and the restriction map $P(\coprod_{a=1}^m U_a)\to\prod_{a=1}^mP(U_a)$ is bijective for every finite family. For its sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], the canonical map $P(W)\to P^\#(W)$ is a bijection, natural in $P$.

source.place: Tag 0F63, lemma-presheaf-value-weakly-contractible, proof: abstract finite-partition refinement form of the same plus-construction argument; the hypotheses on coproducts make the argument independent of schemes.

proof.text: Every covering sieve for J.toGrothendieck contains a covering presieve for J. Prove this by induction on Precoverage.Saturate. A generating cover contains itself. The top sieve contains the identity cover. For a pullback, index the arrows of a contained covering presieve by the sigma type of their domains and witnesses, use the covering-pullback clause of IsSiteForCoverings, and use downward closure to put the resulting cover in the pullback sieve. For transitivity, choose a contained covering presieve R and, for each arrow f of R, a contained cover Q_f in the corresponding pullback sieve. Bind these covers using the composition clause of IsSiteForCoverings; every composite lies in the desired sieve.

source.place: Definition 00VH and the topology generated by a site; induction on the generated covering sieves.

proof.text: Use essentiallySmallSelf to view the site as essentially small in the value universe max(u,v,w). Mathlib GrothendieckTopology.WEqualsLocallyBijective.ofEssentiallySmall transports local bijectivity of the sheafification unit from the equivalent small model. Thus Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem gives a covering sieve of equality for any two sections with the same image, and Presheaf.imageSieve_mem gives a covering sieve of local lifts for any sheafified section. The target of the unit is a sheaf by presheafToSheaf.property.

source.place: Theorem 00WB and Lemma 00WK, implemented using Mathlib Sites.Equivalence and Sites.LocallyBijective.

proof.text: For injectivity, extract an actual cover inside the equalizer sieve by the first step and refine it by a finite decomposition of W. Each component factors through an arrow where the original sections agree. Apply P to the factorization; equality on all components and injectivity of hprod imply equality on W. This includes an empty family.

source.place: Tag 0F63, lemma-presheaf-value-weakly-contractible, finite-partition argument, using local equality.

proof.text: For surjectivity, extract an actual cover inside the image sieve and refine it by a finite decomposition. Choose a lift on each covering arrow through which a component factors, then restrict that lift to the component. Naturality gives a lift of the restricted sheafified section. Surjectivity of hprod assembles the component lifts into p in P(W). Naturality identifies the restriction of the image of p with the given section on each component. The component presieve is a cover by hcover, so the sheaf separatedness axiom gives equality on W. For an empty decomposition, hprod supplies p from the empty product and separatedness on the empty cover supplies equality.

source.place: Tag 0F63, lemma-presheaf-value-weakly-contractible; Sites Tag 00WK, local representatives, and the separatedness part of the sheaf axiom.

proof.text: Evaluate Mathlib toSheafify_naturality at op W to obtain the asserted naturality square. None of the product or initial-value hypotheses on Q is needed for this square.

The item states 0F63 for an abstract site: finite coproducts whose component maps cover, an object W whose covers refine to finite decompositions, and a presheaf P sending finite coproducts to products with P(empty) a singleton. These hypotheses are enough. Disjointness, strictness and pullback stability are unused extra hypotheses, and they hold in the citer's settings. Instead of the source's two plus constructions, the proof argues directly from lem-weil-pbc-site-sheafification-sections-local (00WK/00WB), so proof_origin agent is correct. Steps: step 1 uses the empty covering to make the sheafification a singleton at the empty object (elementary). Step 2 (injectivity) takes the cover where the two sections agree from the last clause of the local lemma, refines it to a finite decomposition, and uses injectivity of the product map. Step 3 (surjectivity) takes local representatives from the first clause, pulls them back to the components, assembles a section with the product bijection, checks its image using naturality of the sheafification unit, and concludes by separatedness on the component cover, which the item's hypothesis makes a covering. Step 4 gets naturality from the universal property (elementary). Each cited statement says exactly what its step takes; in particular, the plus construction is never claimed from the sheafification definition (error C4 avoided). Edge cases checked: W empty, the empty decomposition, a nonempty W with P(W) empty, and a one-component decomposition. Applicability to the citer: an extremally disconnected T and a w-contractible affine both satisfy the refinement property. lean.statement: theorem bijective_toSheafify_of_partition_refinement {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasPullbacks C] [HasFiniteCoproducts C] [HasStrictInitialObjects C] (J : Precoverage C) (hJ : J.IsSiteForCoverings) (hdisjoint : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → C) (X : C) (j : ∀ a, U a ⟶ X), IsColimit (Cofan.mk X j) → ∀ (a b : Fin n), a ≠ b → Nonempty (IsInitial (pullback (j a) (j b)))) (hstable : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → C) (X : C) (j : ∀ a, U a ⟶ X), IsColimit (Cofan.mk X j) → ∀ (Y : C) (f : Y ⟶ X), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk Y (fun a ↦ pullback.snd (j a) f)))) (hcover : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → C) (X : C) (j : ∀ a, U a ⟶ X), IsColimit (Cofan.mk X j) → Presieve.ofArrows U j ∈ J X) (W : C) (hrefine : ∀ (S : Presieve W), S ∈ J W → ∃ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → C) (j : ∀ a, U a ⟶ W), Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk W j)) ∧ ∀ a, ∃ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ W), S f ∧ ∃ h : U a ⟶ V, h ≫ f = j a) (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max u v w)) (hempty : Nonempty (P.obj (op (⊥_ C))) ∧ Subsingleton (P.obj (op (⊥_ C)))) (hprod : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → C) (X : C) (j : ∀ a, U a ⟶ X), IsColimit (Cofan.mk X j) → Function.Bijective (fun s : P.obj (op X) ↦ fun a ↦ P.map (j a).op s)) : Function.Bijective ((toSheafify J.toGrothendieck P).app (op W)) ∧ ∀ (Q : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max u v w)) (_ : Nonempty (Q.obj (op (⊥_ C))) ∧ Subsingleton (Q.obj (op (⊥_ C)))) (_ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Fin n → C) (X : C) (j : ∀ a, U a ⟶ X), IsColimit (Cofan.mk X j) → Function.Bijective (fun s : Q.obj (op X) ↦ fun a ↦ Q.map (j a).op s)) (α : P ⟶ Q), α.app (op W) ≫ (toSheafify J.toGrothendieck Q).app (op W) = (toSheafify J.toGrothendieck P).app (op W) ≫ (sheafifyMap J.toGrothendieck α).app (op W)
